disha_shool.description: West direction is inauspicious on Sunday.

guidance.summary: Today is highly favorable for most activities. The Amavasya tithi (Krishna Paksha) combined with Purva Ashadha nakshatra and Dhruva yoga (auspicious) creates the prevailing cosmic atmosphere. Sunday's solar energy supports authority and vitality - step into leadership roles.
tips: Amavasya is sacred for honoring ancestors - offer prayers and reflect on family lineage.
Purva Ashadha brings the energy of invincibility - face challenges with confidence.
Perfect for laying foundations, making commitments, and permanent decisions.
